sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the conditional universal material rule without imposing material existence, targets the supplied ship owner, enforces the approved evidence state, both authorized authority alternatives, both accepted standard alternatives, and the polar service temperature basis in canonical degrees Celsius. Freeze for later RDF evaluation.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not impose sh:minCount 1 on exposedStructureMaterial: the requirement is universal over applicable materials and does not independently require a material to exist. Encode the approval constraints conditionally for each supplied exposed-structure material, while preserving the declared ship owner, authorized authority and standard alternatives, approved evidence state, and the polarServiceTemperature basis; do not turn those universal checks into unconditional ship-existence requirements.
